item.title: Platform-Ready Packing Checklist
item.description:
Why packing fails expensive POs

For sequin eveningwear, receiving teams reject cartons for barcode mismatches, crushed sequin fields, and missing size assortments—even when the garment itself is fine. Platform-ready packing is part of quality, not an afterthought.

Pre-ship checklist

  1. Polybags — Clear bags sized to avoid sequin crush; include size sticker facing out.
  2. Hangtags / care labels — Fiber content and care symbols matching market rules.
  3. Barcodes — SKU-level codes that scan; verify against the buyer’s ASN template.
  4. Assortment — Ratio packs documented on packing list and carton marks.
  5. Carton strength — Double-wall for dense sequin goods; no over-compression.
  6. Needle detection — Pass records available when required by the buyer.
  7. Photo pack — Sample carton open/close photos archived with the PO.

FBA and 3PL notes

If shipping to Amazon FBA or a third-party warehouse, confirm label placement, carton weight limits, and whether sequin fringe styles need tissue or boards. Sparyn can adapt packing to Fashion Nova, SHEIN, Temu, Windsor Store, and private-label intake rules when specs are shared at sampling.
